about_blocks.text: Medical Detoxification at Medical Detox Ontario
about_blocks.html: Medical Detoxification at Medical Detox Ontario

about_blocks.text: Medical detoxification, or medical detox, is an essential first step in recovering from drug or alcohol addiction. Alcohol withdrawal is a common life-threatening condition for recovering addicts, and it is also true for people getting addiction treatment. At Medical Detox Ontario, we have the utmost dedication to helping those with drug or alcohol addiction problems. With our top-quality medical detox programs, you can be sure to secure a healthier future. Our medical detox program provides a foundation upon which to build new and healthy habits.

about_blocks.text: Convenient Location and VIP Travel Services
about_blocks.html: Convenient Location and VIP Travel Services

about_blocks.text: Medical Detox Ontario is located on the same campus as one of the most exclusive and successful treatment facilities in the province of Ontario and Canada. We are conveniently found 3 hours from the city of Toronto, 2 hours from Montreal, and 1.5 hours from Ottawa, providing easy access to medical detoxification services. Canadians travelling to the Detox Facility from other provinces or countries can easily fly into the Ottawa International Airport and then take advantage of an optional VIP valet service in partnership with the 1000 Islands Wellness & Treatment Centre.

about_blocks.text: Licensed Health Care at Medical Detox Ontario
about_blocks.html: Licensed Health Care at Medical Detox Ontario

about_blocks.text: Licensed medical supervision is the key part of detoxification. At Medical Detox Ontario, we put our clients in the hands of our caring and professional doctor and nursing team. Round-the-clock, 24/7 supervision and care ensure that you are safe as your body deals with withdrawal. We understand that the detoxification process can be tough, which is why we strive to make it as comfortable and stress-free as possible.
